_comment: One entry per employee. Run scripts/build-team-cards.py to regenerate team/<slug>.html and team/<slug>.vcf. Fields left empty or null are omitted from the card and the vCard - nothing is invented.

_fields.name: Full name as it should appear
_fields.title: Job title
_fields.company: Defaults to Finasheet LLC if omitted
_fields.phone: E.164, e.g. +971522015270. Used for tap-to-call and the vCard
_fields.whatsapp: Digits only, e.g. 971522015270. Omit to hide the WhatsApp button
_fields.photo: Path relative to site root, e.g. assets/team/name.webp. Omit to fall back to initials
_fields.tagline: Optional one line under the title
_fields.hero: Full-bleed portrait for the card hero, e.g. assets/team/name-hero.webp. Falls back to photo, then initials
_fields.location: Optional line under the contact rows, e.g. 'United Arab Emirates'
